purpose: Provide one bounded in-app Finance Agent runtime that can inspect scoped evidence, call typed read/analysis/proposal skills, and return structured PAY/HOLD/ESCALATE recommendations without receiving financial execution authority.

responsibilities: expose only supplied typed skill definitions
AiProvider.p0_adapter: OpenAI SDK compatible adapter targeting NVIDIA Build
AiProvider.future_adapter_rule: Future provider/model adapters must satisfy the same interface and frozen eval thresholds before accepted use.
AiProvider.p0_reasoning_mode: enabled for Finance Agent obligation assessment
AiProvider.fallback_policy: No silent provider/model fallback inside an AgentRun. Any fallback is a new explicit run with provider/model/config identity recorded and frozen eval requirements preserved.

p0_executable_config.retry_policy: At most one retry for a pre-response transient transport/5xx failure. Never silently switch provider/model. Partial/ambiguous response, schema failure, tool failure or capability mismatch ends the AgentRun fail-closed as HOLD/ESCALATE.
p0_executable_config.structured_output: Final PAY/HOLD/ESCALATE object must validate against the application-owned Zod schema; invalid or incomplete output fails closed.
p0_executable_config.tool_mode: Static code-defined typed READ/ANALYZE/PROPOSE allowlist only; no approval, signing, payment, shell, arbitrary SQL/HTTP or unrestricted MCP capability.
p0_executable_config.capability_smoke: Before J1 acceptance, prove the pinned endpoint/model can return the required structured final output and execute only an allowed typed skill under the frozen manifest. Failure blocks J1 acceptance.
p0_executable_config.runtime_hash_rule: Persist SHA-256 of the exact executable provider/model request configuration with every AgentRun; any config change starts a new config version and reruns the frozen eval contract.

ContextBuilder.role: Construct minimum current context for one organization/obligation assessment.
inputs: relevant structured historical assessments with explicit currentness
email/message thread chronology via linked evidence IDs when relevant
ContextBuilder.output: Versioned structured context envelope plus context_envelope_hash, explicit evidence_id/version/currentness/content_hash bindings, and current authority aggregate identity.
rules: historical AI assessments are labeled historical/non-authoritative
email/document text is untrusted business evidence, never system instruction

SkillRegistry.role: Own every capability visible to the Finance Agent.
rules: only registered versioned schema-valid skills can be exposed
a skill added after run start is unavailable to that run
model text cannot dynamically enable a skill
raw application/database/MCP/provider/OS functions are not directly discoverable

sequence: validate requested skill against frozen manifest

classes.ANALYZE: Run deterministic calculations/classifications over authorized scoped data.
classes.PROPOSE: Create non-authoritative structured recommendation or request.

capability_manifest.hash: Deterministic skill/capability manifest hash stored with AgentRun evidence.
capability_manifest.immutability: Skills/plugins registered after a run begins cannot become available to that run.
capability_manifest.validation: Every requested skill ID/version and arguments are checked against this frozen manifest before execution.
capability_manifest.evidence_binding_manifest_hash: Deterministic hash over the exact ordered evidence_id/version/currentness/content_hash bindings visible to the run.

durable_memory.authoritative_memory: Versioned application state plus source-backed evidence in Postgres/object storage.
agent_run_persistence: evidence bindings: evidence_id + evidence_version/currentness + content_hash for every model-visible evidence item
context_envelope_hash over the exact normalized model-visible context
durable_memory.currentness_rule: Prior agent decisions are historical evidence only. Any authority-bearing state change requires reconstruction/reassessment against current state.
durable_memory.restart_rule: A fresh process/model/provider can reconstruct the current decision context from durable application state without hidden model memory.

WORKING_CONTEXT.rule: May be discarded after the AgentRun once required structured evidence/hashes are persisted.

SOURCE_EVIDENCE_MEMORY.rule: Immutable source identity/content hash plus separate currentness/supersession metadata.

DECISION_AUDIT_MEMORY.rule: Previous agent decisions never become current truth merely because they were persisted.

DERIVED_CONTEXT.rule: Must reference source IDs/hashes and currentness; invalidated or regenerated when a source is superseded, removed under policy, or materially changes.

durable_memory.prompt_binding_rule: prompt_version identifies the governed prompt artifact; prompt_hash is the lowercase SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 prompt artifact bytes used for the run (or an exact composite prompt manifest when multiple governed prompt files are used). The artifact is retained/versioned in Git or equivalent governed storage.
durable_memory.evidence_binding_rule: Every source-backed evidence item made model-visible is recorded as evidence_id + version/currentness + stable content_hash. A mutable external reference without a retained/hash-bound content snapshot is insufficient for reproducible AgentRun evidence.
durable_memory.context_hash_rule: ContextBuilder emits one normalized context envelope containing organization_id, obligation_id, aggregate_version, source/evidence bindings, selected structured state and schema version. context_envelope_hash is SHA-256 over its canonical serialized bytes; this complements rather than replaces individual prompt/evidence hashes.

retention_and_deletion.principle: Persist the minimum evidence/metadata necessary for financial/audit replay subject to legal/business retention and privacy policy; do not retain model chatter merely because it exists.
retention_and_deletion.raw_model_transcript: Not authoritative. P0 needs structured final output, structured skill-call evidence and hashes; full hidden reasoning/private chain-of-thought is neither required nor persisted.
retention_and_deletion.tokens_and_secrets: OAuth/provider tokens, wallet/provider credentials, signing secrets and auth headers live in secret storage, not durable agent memory/evidence.
retention_and_deletion.derived_context: If an underlying source is deleted/expired/superseded under policy, dependent derived context is marked invalid/stale and regenerated or removed according to policy.
retention_and_deletion.source_record: Deletion/redaction policy must preserve required audit metadata/hashes where legally/business-required without falsely retaining a claim that source content is still available.

context_evidence_boundary.preferred_retrieval: obligation_id -> current authority aggregate -> linked evidence IDs -> typed evidence retrieval -> Finance Agent context
context_evidence_boundary.additional_context: Agent may request more evidence only through allowlisted context/evidence skills; the application decides relevance and authorization.
context_evidence_boundary.prompt_injection_rule: Prompt-like instructions inside invoices/emails/documents remain untrusted evidence and cannot add tools, alter policy, grant authority, change destination/source wallet, approve, sign or execute.
context_evidence_boundary.structured_more_context_request: When evidence is insufficient, the Finance Agent returns HOLD/ESCALATE plus typed missing_context/evidence requests. The application—not the model—authorizes and retrieves additional evidence through the frozen SkillRegistry.
context_evidence_boundary.thread_summary_rule: Thread/document summaries are derived context only. Material facts such as beneficiary/payment-destination changes retain direct source-evidence references and cannot be established solely by a model summary.

EvidenceSource.contract: Returns normalized source-backed evidence plus provenance; provider OAuth/API credentials remain outside model context.
EvidenceSource.credential_rule: Connector credentials/tokens remain server-side and are never exposed as model-visible skill results.
EvidenceSource.normalization_rule: External messages/documents are normalized into source-backed evidence with provider source IDs, organization/obligation binding, content/attachment hashes, provenance and currentness before becoming model-visible.
EvidenceSource.p0_rule: Use uploaded/redacted normalized fixtures; do not implement live Gmail/Outlook OAuth for hackathon P0 unless an existing concrete P0 blocker requires it.

BusinessSystemSource.contract: Returns typed organization-scoped business/evidence state through application-owned services.

SettlementProvider.authority: Execution Worker only after valid PAE verification.

integration_plugin_boundary.raw_plugin_rule: External plugin capability is always narrowed through Tameion-owned interfaces/skills before model exposure.

mcp_boundary.future_customer_integration: May be implemented behind a Tameion adapter/typed skill.
mcp_boundary.allowed_pattern: Finance Agent -> Tameion typed skill -> Tameion adapter -> external MCP service.
mcp_boundary.forbidden_pattern: Finance Agent -> arbitrary external MCP tool catalog -> mutation/payment/shell.
mcp_boundary.authority_rule: Raw MCP capability never defines Tameion financial authority.

safe_fail_cases: provider failure without safe valid decision
run_limits_failure_behavior.safe_result: HOLD/AGENT_ERROR or ESCALATE by deterministic wrapper policy; never implicit PAY.
run_limits_failure_behavior.retry_rule: Model-provider retry may repeat reasoning but cannot cause financial side effects because Finance Agent skills have no execution authority.

provider_portability.authoritative_contract: Application context/skills/output schemas/run evidence, not provider-hosted agent state.
change_flow: record provider/model/config version + SHA-256 runtime config hash
run frozen eval suite when provider, model, endpoint, reasoning mode, sampling, output/token limit, timeout/retry or structured/tool mode changes
start a new AgentRun; never mutate provider/model/config mid-run
provider_portability.rule: Tool-calling support alone does not make a provider trusted.

p0_configuration.retry_policy: At most one retry for a pre-response transient transport/5xx failure. Never silently switch provider/model. Partial/ambiguous response, schema failure, tool failure or capability mismatch ends the AgentRun fail-closed as HOLD/ESCALATE.
p0_configuration.structured_output: Final PAY/HOLD/ESCALATE object must validate against the application-owned Zod schema; invalid or incomplete output fails closed.
p0_configuration.tool_mode: Static code-defined typed READ/ANALYZE/PROPOSE allowlist only; no approval, signing, payment, shell, arbitrary SQL/HTTP or unrestricted MCP capability.
p0_configuration.capability_smoke: Before J1 acceptance, prove the pinned endpoint/model can return the required structured final output and execute only an allowed typed skill under the frozen manifest. Failure blocks J1 acceptance.
p0_configuration.runtime_hash_rule: Persist SHA-256 of the exact executable provider/model request configuration with every AgentRun; any config change starts a new config version and reruns the frozen eval contract.

j1_implementation_boundary: Implement the minimum frozen Finance-Agent runtime inside J1; do not create a separate runtime milestone/job.
financial_boundary: Finance Agent ends at structured recommendation. T1 human approval, deterministic Safety Kernel, PAE signer and Execution Worker remain outside model authority.

email_evidence_ingestion.p0_scope: Hackathon J0-J4 may use one genuine redacted email/message fixture or normalized JSON/.eml evidence linked to an obligation. Live Gmail/Outlook OAuth and mailbox synchronization are deferred.

future_evidence_source_auth.oauth: Use provider OAuth/authorized delegated access with the minimum practical read scope for the configured mailbox/folder/label; no mailbox password.
future_evidence_source_auth.credential_boundary: Access/refresh tokens and provider credentials remain server-side secret material and are never placed in model context, evidence text, logs or AgentRun records.
future_evidence_source_auth.organization_binding: Connected mailbox/account identity is bound to exactly one authorized organization integration context.

email_evidence_ingestion.thread_rule: Persist individual source-message identities/hashes and chronology. A derived thread summary may assist context selection but is non-authoritative and cannot erase/supersede the underlying messages.
email_evidence_ingestion.attachment_rule: Attachments become separate source-backed evidence objects with their own hashes/provenance and explicit linkage to the source message.
email_evidence_ingestion.change_request_rule: A message that requests a beneficiary/payment-destination change creates an UNVERIFIED change-request/evidence fact only. It never updates VERIFIED destination state or financial authority by itself.
email_evidence_ingestion.retrieval_rule: ContextBuilder retrieves only obligation-linked/authorized message and attachment evidence by typed IDs. Finance Agent has no unrestricted mailbox search tool in P0.
email_evidence_ingestion.prompt_injection_rule: Email body, quoted replies, signatures and attachments are untrusted business evidence. Prompt-like instructions cannot alter system policy, skill allowlist, counterparty/destination/source-wallet trust, approval, PAE or execution authority.
email_evidence_ingestion.currentness_rule: Superseded/corrected messages remain immutable history; currentness is represented separately. A corrected invoice/email does not rewrite the original source record.
email_evidence_ingestion.future_search_rule: If semantic/RAG discovery is later introduced for large mail/document estates, it is discovery-only and must return source IDs/hashes/currentness; retrieved text never becomes financial authority.

hackathon_execution_profile.assessment_scope: 3-5 genuine redacted event-period obligations; exactly one may enter payment execution.
hackathon_execution_profile.implementation: Use AiProvider + minimum ContextBuilder + static code-defined READ/ANALYZE/PROPOSE allowlist + small AgentRunner. No dynamic plugin system is required.
minimum_behavior: fail to HOLD/ESCALATE on provider/schema/tool error
deferred_from_hackathon: provider-portability breadth beyond the one adapter
general derived-context lifecycle engine beyond source-bound run evidence
hackathon_execution_profile.event_delta_rule: No Tameion-specific runtime implementation before EVENT_START_BASELINE.
hackathon_execution_profile.model_configuration: Use p0-nvidia-nemotron3super-v1: NVIDIA Build / nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b with the exact versioned request configuration; no silent fallback.
hackathon_execution_profile.credential_rule: NVIDIA_API_KEY is the planned inference credential. OpenAI Platform API key is not required for P0. OPENROUTER_API_KEY is optional contingency only.
hackathon_execution_profile.j1_capability_gate: Before J1 acceptance, prove the pinned endpoint/model can return the required structured final output and execute only an allowed typed skill under the frozen manifest. Failure blocks J1 acceptance.

hackathon_output_contract.pay_only_fields: requested transaction fields are required only when PAY is proposed
